name: Ubuntu 24.04 Cloud Dev Box (SSH + Claude Code)
description: Always-on Ubuntu box with SSH, tmux and AI coding CLIs on persistent disk.

SSH_PASSWORD.description: Password for SSH as user 'dev', generated at deploy. Clear it for key-only SSH (then set SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS). Minimum 12 characters.

SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS.description: Recommended. Your SSH public key(s) for user 'dev', one per line (several on one line also work). Keys added to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys persist too.

WEB_PASSWORD.description: Password (user 'dev') for the status page and web terminal on the public URL. Generated at deploy; only /healthz is public. Minimum 12 characters.

WEB_TERMINAL.description: Browser terminal (ttyd) at /terminal/ behind WEB_PASSWORD. Set to false to keep only the status page.

PORT.description: HTTP port for the healthcheck, status page and web terminal; the public domain targets it.

TZ.description: Time zone for shells and tools, e.g. Europe/Istanbul.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Claude Code uses this Anthropic API key instead of a Claude subscription login.

CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.description: Optional. Long-lived Claude subscription token from `claude setup-token`, for headless use without the login prompt.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. OpenAI API key for Codex CLI (alternative to `codex login --device-auth` with ChatGPT).

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Gemini API key (Google AI Studio) for Gemini CLI; the simplest login on a remote box.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Optional. Lets OpenCode use OpenRouter models. Other providers: run `opencode auth login`.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional GitHub token for gh and HTTPS git (set up as git credential helper at start).

GIT_REPO.description: Optional repository URL cloned once into ~/workspace on first start (private repos need GITHUB_TOKEN).

APT_PACKAGES.description: Optional space-separated Ubuntu packages reinstalled in the background at every start (apt installs do not survive redeploys).

DEVBOX_ENV_PASSTHROUGH.description: Optional comma-separated names of extra variables to expose in SSH and web terminal shells.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Grace period for sshd, the web terminal and Caddy to stop cleanly on redeploy.
